thaumicenergistics.page.START: AE networks can store essentia as a native resource. Ordinary terminals, buses, monitors and level emitters support it. No separate essentia buses are needed.
thaumicenergistics.page.CORES: AE networks can store essentia as a native resource. Ordinary terminals, buses, monitors and level emitters support it. No separate essentia buses are needed.
tc.research_text.thaumicenergistics:STOR: Can this thing really store essentia?
thaumicenergistics.page.STORAGE: Install essentia cells in ME drives. Configure partitions in the AE Cell Workbench. Use phials, jars or an ampoule at a terminal to transfer essentia. The microscope inspects a cell held in your other hand. An empty cell can be disassembled by sneaking and using it.
thaumicenergistics.page.IO: Connect providers to a powered network. Essentia providers feed tubes; infusion providers supply nearby infusion consumers. The advanced provider requests missing essentia through AE crafting CPUs. Encode a distillation pattern using one input sample and a blank pattern, then install it in a pattern provider serving an alchemical furnace. Import the resulting essentia using ordinary import buses.
thaumicenergistics.page.ARCANE_TERMINAL: Browse, search, insert and extract network resources using the native ME terminal. Put ingredients and a wand in the crafting area; Craft uses your research and vis. Refill fetches matching ingredients from the network.

thaumicenergistics.page.IRON_GEARBOX: Sneak-use toggles input/output. An output interface supplies nearby vis relays from the same ME network. A vis interface collects centivis from an energized node network and supplies arcane machines on the same ME grid. The creative interface provides unlimited primal vis. Vibration chambers burn Ignis or Potentia for AE power. Iron gearboxes turn adjacent crankable machines; thaumium gearboxes also accept use-core golems.

thaumicenergistics.page.QUARTZ: Duplicate Certus Quartz in a crucible with four Vitreus and two Aqua. Nether Quartz also needs two Potentia.
thaumicenergistics.page.VIS: Sneak-use an AE memory card on the input interface, then use it on an output in the same ME network. Each output draws only from its bound input. Multiple outputs may share an input.
thaumicenergistics.page.ARCANE_ASSEMBLER: Insert a wand to the left of the core. The assembler pays vis from this wand, including cap, wand type and armor discounts. A linked vis interface recharges it. Recipes recorded in the knowledge core, the separate soul core or the wand's soul core can each authorize crafting independently. The assembler advertises recipes directly to ME crafting CPUs without a pattern provider. Power and acceleration cards still control operation.
thaumicenergistics.page.KNOWLEDGE_INSCRI: Place a knowledge core and set the ghost recipe matrix. Save an unlocked arcane recipe; saving an existing output removes it. Select a stored output to load its matrix. Each core holds 21 recipes.
thaumicenergistics.page.TOOLS: Sneak with the wrench focus attached to a wand. Left click rotates; right click dismantles. A successful operation consumes 10 centivis each of air and fire before discounts.

thaumicenergistics.page.GOLEMS: Link a backpack in an AE wireless access point, then equip a Gather, Fill, Liquid or Essentia golem. It still requires wireless coverage and network power. Gather stores collected items; Fill and Liquid draw from ME to supply home. Essentia golems import from a transport home or fill marked labeled jars from ME when placed on ordinary blocks. Sneak with an empty hand to remove the backpack. AE facades customize its appearance.
thaumicenergistics.page.MICROSCOPE: Hold use while aiming at a dropped cell, ME drive or ME chest. Stored items are scanned into your Thaumcraft knowledge after 45 ticks.

thaumicenergistics.page.WIRELESS_ARCANE: Link the terminal to an AE wireless access point and keep it powered and connected. Four upgrade slots hold up to two Energy Cards, one Quantum Bridge Card and one Wireless Vis Card. A Quantum Bridge Card and a paired Quantum Entangled Singularity connect remotely through a loaded, powered bridge on the same network, using 22.5 AE/t. A Wireless Vis Card charges only the internal wand from input vis interfaces on that network. The wand button enables inventory wands for crafting: the internal wand is preferred, then each inventory wand is tried for the entire cost. Vis is never pooled across wands.
